sources.note: Infinx main site. No mention of EHR product at all — focuses entirely on AI-powered patient access and revenue cycle management solutions. Based in Cupertino, CA.
Mandatory disclosures URL from CHPL metadata. Returned 404 at time of research — page no longer exists.
Press release about Infinx acquiring i3 Verticals Healthcare RCM business for $96M in May 2025. Confirms acquisition brought healthcare products including EHR under Infinx umbrella.
Coverage of the Infinx/i3 Verticals acquisition. Describes deal as expanding Infinx into academic medical centers and large provider groups.
Additional coverage of acquisition with strategic rationale details.
i3 Verticals Healthcare products page. Returned 403 at time of research, but search engine cached results showed: HPlusPro billing, EHR, scheduling, analytics, patient portal products.

i3 Verticals Healthcare homepage. Returned 403. Cached search results described medical billing software for multi-location practices, labs, hospital-based physicians, radiology, and medical billing companies.

i3 Verticals clinical operations page. Returned 404. Cached search results described EHR for clinical/administrative data, patient portal, scheduling, appointment reminders, online registration, secure Direct messaging.
i3 Verticals patient engagement page. Returned 404. Cached results described patient portal integrated with i3 EHR for medical and administrative data access.
iMed Software announcement about acquisition by i3 Verticals on April 30, 2022. Page returned 404 but search results confirmed the acquisition and rebranding to i3Med.

FindEMR review of iMedEMR/i3Med. Listed features: clinical documentation, patient engagement, quality reporting, population health, APM modules, scheduling, e-prescribing, telemedicine, mobile app. 10 reviews averaging highly positive. Integrations: Advanced MD, DrFirst, Athenahealth, Duxware, Meditech, Labcorp, Boston Heart Diagnostics, Allscripts.

SoftwareFinder review of iMedEMR. Described as cloud-based EHR+PM for ambulatory. 4.5/5 stars from 10 reviews. Features: EHR, RCM, online registration, secure messaging, appointment reminders, patient charts. Integrations with Advanced MD, DrFirst, Labcorp, etc.

360Quadrants profile. Founded 2002 in Louisiana. Revenue below $10M. Ranked 123rd in EHR category. Features: multi-site coordination, document management (scanned letters, X-rays, dictation audio, lab results), MS Word/OpenOffice integration, e-prescribing.

SourceForge listing for HPlusPro (i3 Verticals billing product). Primarily billing/RCM — not EHR. Starting at $275/user/month. Cloud-based. No user reviews. Integrates with CGM LABDAQ, Nexus EHR, Polytech LIS.
SourceForge listing for iMedEMR. Confirmed cloud-based EHR with lab/test management, e-prescribing, population health features.
Infinx about page. Describes company as founded 2012, focused on AI-powered RCM and patient access. No mention of EHR product.
Becker's coverage of the Infinx acquisition of i3 Verticals healthcare business.
